sections.label: Retrenchment numbers and outlook
sections.summary: 13,440 workers were retrenched last year, and the number is expected to be higher this year due to restructuring and slowing growth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In total, 13,440 workers were retrenched last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: We expect the number this year to be higher due to ongoing business restructuring and slowing economic growth.

sections.label: Companies paying retrenchment benefits
sections.summary: A 2013 survey found nine out of 10 companies with at least 25 employees paid retrenchment benefits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Even so, based on the last survey conducted in 2013, nine out of 10 companies with at least 25 employees did pay retrenchment benefits.

sections.label: Strengthening retrenchment reporting framework
sections.summary: MOM is consulting unions and employers to strengthen the framework for retrenchment reporting to reach more retrenched workers with timely assistance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: To enable us to reach more retrenched workers and offer more timely assistance to them, MOM is now in consultation with unions and employers to strengthen our framework for retrenchment reporting.

sections.label: Assistance to retrenched workers
sections.summary: In the first nine months of this year, more than 3,000 retrenched workers were assisted, and close to 2,000 of the 3,300 secured new jobs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In the first nine months of this year, we have assisted more than 3,000 retrenched workers under this special arrangement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Of the 3,300, we were able to help close to 2,000 secure new jobs and new employment.

sections.label: Timely reporting and employment survey
sections.summary: MOM is exploring with unions and employers to strengthen retrenchment reporting so retrenched workers can be reached earlier, and is surveying employment landscape changes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Because  the longer they stay out of a job, the harder it would be for them to come back to work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: And that is the reason why MOM is now exploring with the unions and the employers to strengthen the retrenchment reporting framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Because we believe that with more timely reporting, we will be able to reach out to these retrenched workers earlier so that we can help them even more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: We are now doing a survey on the changes in the employment landscape.
